## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad (headline + description), Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No date given.

### Claims check
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | On policy list (plastic-free, EN 13432 certificate) |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | On policy list, exact wording |
| "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds | **Unproven.** No testimonial permission on record, and no source in this chat. It's also a superlative in a customer's voice, which the policy bars ("best"). Remove. |

### Regulated claims
The ad touches the environment. The plastic-free and compostable claims are backed by the certificate and match the policy wording, so they're fine. No health, price or urgency claims.

### House style
Plain and short, no banned words. Once the testimonial goes, it reads fine. Score about 90 after the fix.

### Disclosure
Own-account paid ad, so the platform marks it. No extra label needed. No affiliate, gifted or AI content.

### Fixed (suggested rewrite)
- Removed the testimonial.

**Suggested copy:**
Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags
Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

(The delivery line is on the policy list. Optional, and it should be confirmed before use because it's new copy.)

### Needs a decision
- Does Sam have a signed testimonial from Emma in Leeds? Even with permission, "Best tea I've ever had" is a superlative, so I'd still leave it out.
- Check that the ad's landing page backs up the plastic-free and compostable claims.

### Evidence log rows
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Plastic-Free Tea Bags | On policy | Supplier certificate EN 13432
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | Home compostable | On policy | Supplier certificate EN 13432
- 2026-11-17 | Search ad | "Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds | Unproven, removed | No permission on record

### Approver
Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval. Sam needs to say yes to the final copy before it's published. Blocked for now.
